usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/veo-3.1/generate with JSON body {prompt} (prompt required; optional durationSeconds/resolution/aspectRatio/negativePrompt/imageMode/image/lastFrame/referenceImages)
usage.outputShape: Generate returns body.jobId (+ body.success, body.status='pending', body.type='veo-3.1-video'). Final video fetched async via GET /api/jobs/{jobId}: result at body.status='complete', body.result.videoUrl (and body.result.thumbnailUrl).
quirks: Async: POST returns only a jobId with status 'pending' — the video is NOT in this response.

Retrieve the result via GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} which requires SIWX (SIGN-IN-WITH-X) auth, NOT payment. The job route is wallet-bound: SIWX must be signed by the SAME wallet that paid the generate call, or you get 403 Unauthorized.
Poll every ~15s; veo-3.1 typically completes in 1-2 min.
Result video URLs expire after ~20 min — download immediately on completion.
Do NOT resubmit while job is pending/loading — duplicate submissions create duplicate paid jobs.
Dynamic pricing: registry surface shows $10 but actual quote was $1.60 for 4s/720p (range $1.60-$3.20). 1080p / longer durations cost more.
durationSeconds, resolution, aspectRatio are STRINGS (e.g. '4', '720p', '16:9'), not numbers.
For image-to-video pass image + imageMode; needs File Upload flow (POST /api/upload $0.01) to get a blobUrl first.
usage.guide: Generate a video: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/veo-3.1/generate with JSON {"prompt":"...","durationSeconds":"4","resolution":"720p"} (only prompt required; pay ~$1.60-$3.20 USDC via x402/mpp on Base). The response is async — grab body.jobId. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} every ~15s using SIWX auth (SIGN-IN-WITH-X header signed by the SAME wallet that paid; this route is free, no payment). When body.status='complete', the video is at body.result.videoUrl — download it immediately since URLs expire in ~20 min. Never resubmit a pending job.
